title: Scheduled System Maintenance Notice
paragraphs: Our team will perform scheduled maintenance on the internal network this Saturday from 10 pm to 2 am. Within this window, expect some downtime, and the file server may face a short outage.

This maintenance follows a minor incident last week when several employees could not connect to our network while working remote. Our engineers have already found the cause and will restore full access before the maintenance window ends.
If you still cannot log in after 2 am, please try resetting your credential through the support portal. If the problem continues, open a helpdesk ticket, and an engineer will help you fix the issue.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To inform employees about scheduled system maintenance
To announce a permanent shutdown of the network
To request approval for a new server

questions.stem: What caused the team to schedule this maintenance?
options: A request from the helpdesk staff
A minor incident with network connections last week

questions.stem: What should an employee do if login still fails after 2 am?
options: Reset the credential through the support portal

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the engineers mentioned in the notice?
options: They are unaware of the outage
They will not respond to new tickets
They plan to remove the internal network entirely
They already identified the cause of the incident that happened last week
